root_cause_explanation: The RAG book index contains 17 public-domain classic literature texts (Project Gutenberg). The frontend 'Library Books' sidebar fetches modern bestsellers from the backend catalog database (MongoDB via getPopularBooks API). These are two completely separate datasets with ZERO overlap. Every book shown in the frontend sidebar has a work_id that does not exist in the RAG index.

recommended_fix.option_A: Change the frontend to show only RAG-indexed books in the sidebar (filter catalog books against a new /rag/books endpoint that returns indexed work_ids).
recommended_fix.option_B: Ingest the catalog bestsellers into the RAG book index (requires obtaining their full text, which may not be freely available for copyrighted modern books).
recommended_fix.option_C: Show both sections in the sidebar: 'RAG-Indexed Books' (the 17 classics) and 'Catalog Books' (the bestsellers, but marked as not available for Q&A).
